query:
INSERT INTO blackjacks (
                dealer,
                player,
                state,
                owner_id,
                staked,
                channel_id,
                message_id
            )
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5::bigint, $6, $7)
            RETURNING
                id,
                dealer,
                player,
                state as "state: BlackjackState",
                channel_id,
                message_id,
                owner_id,
                CAST(staked AS BIGINT) as "staked!"
